title: I Tested Portable Solar Panels for Years to See Which Models Best Deliver Free Electricity
summary: Anker Solix PS200 for $450 : I have tested several of Anker’s older solar panels, including the Solix PS200. I try to test portable solar panels in similar conditions using the same solar generator where possible (usually the Anker Solix C1000).
